# Godot Survival Core Lite

> Free, MIT-licensed Godot 4 survival crafting starter kit / template in typed GDScript for Godot 4.7, with 48 passing headless tests (`bash tools/run_tests.sh`). The Pro edition (€12, commercial EULA, 144 tests) keeps the same API and adds the full feature set.

Copy `addons/survival_core/` into a Godot 4 project to use it. Content is data-driven (`examples/data/content.json`).

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/openclawaimac/godot-survival-core-lite/blob/main/README.md): features, quickstart, API, Lite vs Pro
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/openclawaimac/godot-survival-core-lite/blob/main/AGENTS.md): structure, how to extend, how to run tests, rules for coding agents
- [Website](https://openclawaimac.github.io/godot-survival-core/): product page with Lite vs Pro table

## Code

- [addons/survival_core/survival_stats.gd](https://github.com/openclawaimac/godot-survival-core-lite/tree/main/addons/survival_core/survival_stats.gd): SurvivalStats: hunger/thirst, starvation, regen, died signal
- [addons/survival_core/day_night_clock.gd](https://github.com/openclawaimac/godot-survival-core-lite/tree/main/addons/survival_core/day_night_clock.gd): DayNightClock: time of day, phases, light_level()
- [addons/survival_core/inventory.gd](https://github.com/openclawaimac/godot-survival-core-lite/tree/main/addons/survival_core/inventory.gd): Inventory: slots and stacks
- [addons/survival_core/recipe_book.gd](https://github.com/openclawaimac/godot-survival-core-lite/tree/main/addons/survival_core/recipe_book.gd): RecipeBook: data-driven crafting
- [addons/survival_core/gatherable.gd](https://github.com/openclawaimac/godot-survival-core-lite/tree/main/addons/survival_core/gatherable.gd): Gatherable resource nodes with hits, depletion, respawn
- [examples/](https://github.com/openclawaimac/godot-survival-core-lite/tree/main/examples/): demo.tscn (main scene, CC0 sprites), lite_demo, data/content.json
- [tests/](https://github.com/openclawaimac/godot-survival-core-lite/tree/main/tests/): strict headless suite
- [tools/](https://github.com/openclawaimac/godot-survival-core-lite/tree/main/tools/): run_tests.sh, make_release.sh
